We believe that great challenges require bold thinking, collaboration, and curiosity. We are driven by the desire to explore, experiment, and develop innovative approaches that connect technology with real-world challenges.
summary:
ECHOES OF SPACE is an interactive 3D space museum designed to bring NASA’s forgotten space equipment back to life. Through immersive exploration of the Moon, Mars, and beyond, users can discover abandoned landers, rovers, scientific instruments, helicopters, and spacecraft from real NASA missions. The project combines 3D environments, interactive mission markers, historical timelines, and engaging storytelling to explain what each piece of equipment was, why it was sent, how it worked, and what it contributed to science.
Our project addresses the challenge “Abandoned but not Forgotten” by transforming forgotten space technology into accessible and engaging stories, helping people understand that these objects still hold scientific and historical value. It is important because it preserves the legacy of space exploration, inspires the next generation of explorers, and shows that even when a mission ends, its discoveries and impact live on.
details:
ECHOES OF SPACE is an interactive 3D educational experience that transforms space exploration history into an immersive journey. Users can explore the Moon, Mars, and beyond, select mission markers to discover real NASA equipment, listen to narrated stories, and explore interactive timelines showing the history of each mission.

The platform provides an engaging way to learn about forgotten spacecraft, landers, rovers, and scientific instruments. Each mission includes historical information, its purpose, how the equipment worked, and its scientific contributions.

Our main benefit is making complex scientific and historical information accessible, interactive, and enjoyable for students aged 12–17. We aim to inspire curiosity about science, technology, engineering, and space exploration while preserving the legacy of NASA missions.

What makes our project creative is its combination of a 3D space museum, interactive storytelling, audio narration, and chronological exploration. Instead of simply reading facts, users feel like explorers discovering the history of these machines.

We developed the experience using Canva Code, with web-based technologies and interactive 3D elements. Our technical approach focuses on 3D visualization, animations, interactive navigation, audio, and NASA's publicly available data, photographs, and mission resources.

Throughout development, we considered scientific accuracy, educational value, accessibility, usability, visual engagement, and performance to create an experience that is both informative and exciting.
